detail.longDescription: Productive Weekend In My Homelab: - Deployed nexus repository in my K8s cluster - Configured a few proxy repos - Deployed renovate in my K8s cluster - Updated my Chart.yaml files to use my new proxy repos - Updated ArgoCD to also use my new proxy repos - Almost done "GitOpsing" my compose files.
